uses: Rocket fuel, ammonia production, hydrogenation, fuel cells
triviaEn: Hydrogen is the most abundant element in the universe, making up about 75% of all baryonic mass. It powers the Sun through nuclear fusion.
triviaZh: 氢是宇宙中最丰富的元素，约占所有重子质量的75%。太阳通过氢的核聚变发光发热。
roomTempNoteEn: Colorless, odorless gas. Extremely flammable — forms explosive mixtures with air.
roomTempNoteZh: 无色无味气体，极易燃，与空气混合形成爆炸性气体。
compoundsEn: Water (H₂O), ammonia (NH₃), methane (CH₄), hydrochloric acid (HCl), hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)
compoundsZh: 水(H₂O)、氨气(NH₃)、甲烷(CH₄)、盐酸(HCl)、过氧化氢(H₂O₂)

uses: Balloons, cooling MRI magnets, welding shield gas
Batteries, ceramics, glass, mood stabilizer medication
Aerospace alloys, X-ray windows, nuclear reactors
Steel, plastics, fuel, diamonds, life itself
mnemonicEn: Carbon is the backbone of life
triviaEn: Carbon forms more compounds than any other element — over 10 million organic compounds are known. Diamond and graphite are both pure carbon but with entirely different structures.
triviaZh: 碳形成的化合物比任何元素都多——已知的有机化合物超过1000万种。金刚石和石墨都是纯碳，但结构完全不同。
roomTempNoteEn: Exists in multiple allotropes: graphite (soft, black, conductive), diamond (hardest natural material, transparent, insulating).
roomTempNoteZh: 存在多种同素异形体：石墨（软、黑色、导电）、金刚石（最硬天然物质、透明、绝缘）。
compoundsEn: Carbon dioxide (CO₂), methane (CH₄), calcium carbonate (CaCO₃), glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆)
compoundsZh: 二氧化碳(CO₂)、甲烷(CH₄)、碳酸钙(CaCO₃)、葡萄糖(C₆H₁₂O₆)
colorZh: 黑色（石墨）/ 无色透明（金刚石）

mnemonicEn: Nitrogen makes up most of our air

triviaEn: Oxygen was independently discovered by Carl Wilhelm Scheele (1772) and Joseph Priestley (1774). Priestley called it 'dephlogisticated air'. It makes up 21% of Earth's atmosphere.
triviaZh: 氧由舍勒(1772年)和普利斯特里(1774年)独立发现。普利斯特里称其为'脱燃素空气'。氧气占地球大气的21%。
roomTempNoteEn: Colorless, odorless gas. Highly reactive — supports combustion. Exists as O₂ molecules.
roomTempNoteZh: 无色无味气体，反应活性高，支持燃烧。以O₂分子形式存在。
compoundsEn: Water (H₂O), carbon dioxide (CO₂), silica (SiO₂), rust (Fe₂O₃), sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄)
compoundsZh: 水(H₂O)、二氧化碳(CO₂)、二氧化硅(SiO₂)、铁锈(Fe₂O₃)、硫酸(H₂SO₄)

colorZh: 无色气体（通电发红橙色光）

uses: Table salt (NaCl), street lights, industrial chemicals
triviaEn: Sodium was first isolated by Humphry Davy in 1807 using electrolysis. It is so reactive that it must be stored in oil to prevent it from reacting with air or water.
triviaZh: 钠由汉弗莱·戴维于1807年通过电解法首次分离。钠极其活泼，必须保存在油中以防与空气或水反应。
roomTempNoteEn: Soft silvery metal that can be cut with a knife. Reacts violently with water, producing hydrogen gas and heat.
roomTempNoteZh: 柔软的银白色金属，可用刀切割。遇水剧烈反应，产生氢气和热量。
compoundsEn: Table salt (NaCl), baking soda (NaHCO₃), soda ash (Na₂CO₃), sodium hydroxide (NaOH)

uses: Lightweight alloys, fireworks, flash photography, chlorophyll

mnemonicEn: The most abundant metal in Earth's crust
mnemonicZh: 地壳中含量最高的金属
triviaEn: Aluminium was once more valuable than gold. Napoleon III served dinner on aluminium plates to his most honored guests, while others used gold. It is the most abundant metal in Earth's crust.
triviaZh: 铝曾经比黄金还贵。拿破仑三世用铝制餐盘招待最尊贵的客人，其他客人则用金盘。铝是地壳中最丰富的金属。
roomTempNoteEn: Lightweight silvery metal. Forms a thin protective oxide layer that prevents further corrosion. Good conductor of heat and electricity.
roomTempNoteZh: 轻质银白色金属。表面形成致密氧化膜防腐蚀。良好的导热和导电体。
compoundsEn: Alumina (Al₂O₃), bauxite, alum KAl(SO₄)₂·12H₂O, aluminum hydroxide Al(OH)₃
compoundsZh: 氧化铝(Al₂O₃)、铝土矿、明矾KAl(SO₄)₂·12H₂O、氢氧化铝Al(OH)₃

uses: Computer chips, glass, concrete, solar cells
mnemonicEn: Silicon Valley runs on silicon chips

colorZh: 白色 / 红色 / 黑色

uses: Sulfuric acid, rubber vulcanization, gunpowder, matches
Water disinfection, PVC plastic, bleach, swimming pools
triviaEn: Chlorine was first used as a chemical weapon in WWI (1915). Today it is essential for water purification, saving millions of lives from waterborne diseases.
triviaZh: 氯在一战(1915年)首次被用作化学武器。如今氯是水净化的关键，拯救了数百万人的生命。
roomTempNoteEn: Greenish-yellow gas with a choking smell. Heavier than air. Highly toxic in concentrated form.
roomTempNoteZh: 黄绿色气体，有窒息性气味，比空气重，高浓度时剧毒。
compoundsEn: Table salt (NaCl), bleach (NaClO), PVC plastic, hydrochloric acid (HCl), chloroform (CHCl₃)

uses: Welding shield gas, light bulbs, laser surgery
Fertilizers, soap, glass, essential nutrient for plants
mnemonicEn: K for kalium, essential for plants

uses: Bones, teeth, cement, cheese making, calcium supplements
mnemonicZh: 骨骼和牙齿的主要成分
triviaEn: Calcium compounds have been used for thousands of years — the Romans used lime mortar in construction. Calcium is essential for all living organisms; it's the most abundant metal in the human body.
triviaZh: 钙化合物已使用了几千年——古罗马人用石灰砂浆建筑。钙对所有生命体都至关重要，是人体中含量最丰富的金属。
roomTempNoteEn: Soft gray metal. Reacts with water, producing hydrogen. Quickly tarnishes in air.
roomTempNoteZh: 柔软的灰色金属，与水反应产生氢气，在空气中迅速失去光泽。
compoundsEn: Limestone (CaCO₃), gypsum (CaSO₄·2H₂O), quicklime (CaO), hydroxyapatite Ca₅(PO₄)₃(OH) (bones & teeth)
compoundsZh: 石灰石(CaCO₃)、石膏(CaSO₄·2H₂O)、生石灰(CaO)、羟基磷灰石Ca₅(PO₄)₃(OH)(骨骼和牙齿)

uses: Aerospace alloys, stadium lights, sports equipment
mnemonicEn: Rare metal for high-end sports gear

Stainless steel, chrome plating, dyes, emeralds
Steel production, batteries, glass coloring, enzymes
mnemonicEn: Purple permanganate is a strong oxidizer

uses: Steel, construction, transport, hemoglobin in blood
mnemonicEn: The most used metal in the world
triviaEn: Iron is the most abundant element on Earth by mass (32.1%). The Earth's core is primarily iron and nickel. The Iron Age (1200 BC) marked a major technological revolution.
triviaZh: 铁是地球上质量最丰富的元素(32.1%)。地核主要由铁和镍组成。铁器时代(公元前1200年)标志着重大技术革命。
roomTempNoteEn: Grayish, lustrous metal. Magnetic. Rusts in moist air — reacts with oxygen and water to form hydrated iron oxide.
roomTempNoteZh: 灰色有光泽金属，有磁性，在潮湿空气中生锈——与氧气和水反应形成水合氧化铁。
compoundsEn: Rust (Fe₂O₃·xH₂O), magnetite (Fe₃O₄), hematite (Fe₂O₃), steel (Fe + C), hemoglobin
compoundsZh: 铁锈(Fe₂O₃·xH₂O)、磁铁矿(Fe₃O₄)、赤铁矿(Fe₂O₃)、钢(Fe+C)、血红蛋白

mnemonicZh: 电池和蓝色颜料的金属

uses: Electrical wiring, plumbing, coins, antimicrobial surfaces
mnemonicEn: The red metal that conducts electricity
mnemonicZh: 人类最早使用的金属之一
triviaEn: Copper was the first metal worked by humans (~9000 BC). The Statue of Liberty contains 80 tons of copper. Copper is naturally antimicrobial — bacteria die within hours on copper surfaces.
triviaZh: 铜是人类最早加工的金属(约公元前9000年)。自由女神像含80吨铜。铜天然抗菌——细菌在铜表面数小时内死亡。
roomTempNoteEn: Reddish-orange metal, malleable and ductile. Develops green patina (verdigris) when exposed to moist air over time.
roomTempNoteZh: 红橙色金属，延展性好。长期暴露在潮湿空气中会形成绿色铜绿。

mnemonicEn: Traces in the K-T boundary layer
The king of metals, forever shiny
triviaEn: Gold is one of the least reactive elements — it does not tarnish or rust. All the gold ever mined would fit into a cube about 22 meters on each side. It is edible and used in gourmet cuisine.
triviaZh: 金是最不活泼的元素之一——不会氧化变色。人类历史上开采的所有黄金可装满一个边长约22米的立方体。金可食用，用于高级料理。
roomTempNoteEn: Dense, soft, shiny yellow metal. The most malleable metal — 1 gram can be beaten into a sheet of 1 m².
roomTempNoteZh: 致密、柔软、闪亮的黄色金属。延展性最好的金属——1克金可打成1平方米的金箔。
compoundsEn: Gold rarely forms natural compounds; auric chloride (AuCl₃), potassium dicyanoaurate K[Au(CN)₂]
compoundsZh: 金很少形成天然化合物；氯化金(AuCl₃)、二氰合金酸钾K[Au(CN)₂]

mnemonicEn: The only liquid metal at room temperature
triviaEn: Mercury has been known since ancient times. The ancient Chinese believed it was the elixir of life. It is the only metal liquid at room temperature, forming shiny, mobile droplets.
triviaZh: 汞自古已知，古代中国人认为它是长生不老药。它是唯一常温下呈液态的金属，形成闪亮流动的液滴。
roomTempNoteEn: Shiny, silvery liquid metal. Highly toxic — absorbed through skin and vapor. Forms amalgams with many metals.
roomTempNoteZh: 闪亮的银白色液态金属。剧毒——可通过皮肤和蒸气吸收。与许多金属形成汞齐。

mnemonicEn: Highly toxic, once used as rat poison

mnemonicZh: 彩虹色晶体的低毒金属
colorZh: 银白色（氧化层呈彩虹色）
